name: plan-arm
description: The migrated blacksmith plan arm as a CodeArmory workflow: req -> architect -> test-writer -> (expected-red) -> dev -> (green) -> sast/sca -> sec-review -> lint -> quality-review -> publish. A forge git CLONE brings the repo's .git into the shared volume; blacksmith/agent ACTIONS write plain files on top (the service arm does not commit — service_http.go); the forge/run STEPS do the deterministic work (checks, scanners) between them. The publish step commits the run's work onto a run/${run_id} branch and opens a git-factory PR to dev for a human to judge — it never pushes to the ref directly. Trigger with inputs {task, repo}; repo is the git-factory repo NAME under ops/.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: the git-factory repo name (under ops/) to clone and open the dev PR against

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/r -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"name\":\"$REPO\",\"visibility\":\"private\"}"); case "$CODE" in 201|409) ;; *) echo "repo create failed $CODE"; cat /tmp/r; exit 1;; esac; if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "$GIT_URL" main >/dev/null 2>&1; then D=$(mktemp -d); git -C "$D" init -q; git -C "$D" -c user.email=blacksmith@codearmory -c user.name=blacksmith commit -q --allow-empty -m 'chore: init main'; git -C "$D" push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/main; fi; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q main; echo 'cloned:'; git log --oneline -1

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && cd /workspace && go build -o /tmp/gobin/ ./... && go vet ./... && if go test ./... ; then echo 'FAIL: tests are green before dev'; exit 1; else echo 'OK: tests compile and are RED'; fi
export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && cd /workspace && go build -o /tmp/gobin/ ./... && go test ./...

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && cd /workspace && mkdir -p scan && (go run github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@latest -quiet ./... > scan/sast.txt 2>&1 || true) && echo sast-done

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && cd /workspace && mkdir -p scan && (go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest ./... > scan/sca.txt 2>&1 || true) && echo sca-done

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && cd /workspace && mkdir -p scan && (go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@latest ./... > scan/lint.txt 2>&1 || true) && echo lint-done

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && cd /workspace && echo '=== TREE ===' && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort && echo '=== go test ===' && (go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -20) && echo '=== scan ===' && (cat scan/*.txt 2>/dev/null | head -40 || true)

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; BASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD); printf 'scan/
/tmp/
' > .gitignore; git add -A; if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo 'no changes from the stages — nothing to publish'; exit 0; fi; git -c user.email=blacksmith@codearmory -c user.name=blacksmith commit -q -m "run ${run_id}: ${inputs.task}"; if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "$GIT_URL" dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then git push "$GIT_URL" "$BASE":refs/heads/dev; fi; BR=run/${run_id}; git push "$GIT_URL" HEAD:refs/heads/$BR; RID=$(curl -s "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '
' | grep ""name":"$REPO"" | sed -E 's/.*"id":"([^"]+)".*/\1/' | head -1); PR=$(curl -s -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{"title":"run/${run_id}: ${inputs.task}","source_ref":"$BR","target_ref":"dev"}"); echo "$PR"; echo "PR_URL=$GF/repos/$RID/pulls"; echo PR_OPENED
